name: ELIX Files
description: Modern high-performance file manager and storage navigator with quick preview, archive utilities, and AI tool bindings for ELIX OS
author: ELIX Systems

permissions.reason: Browse directories, inspect file metadata, and preview document content
Create archives, organize folder hierarchies, and delete files
Notify user upon archive completion or file operation status

capabilities.name: list_directory
capabilities.description: List files and subdirectories with sorting, hidden file toggles, and metadata summaries.

capabilities.name: search_files
capabilities.description: Perform fuzzy and recursive file search across directory trees with extension filters.

capabilities.name: inspect_file_metadata
capabilities.description: Inspect detailed file system metadata (size, MIME type, POSIX permissions, birth/mod times).

capabilities.name: manage_archive
capabilities.description: Compress files/folders into a ZIP archive or extract archives with directory traversal protection.

capabilities.name: get_storage_breakdown
capabilities.description: Query storage utilization breakdown across drives, document caches, and partitions.

drivePath.description: Target mount point or drive letter
